title: SupremeAI Dynamic Task Router and Model-Chain Orchestrator
description: Layer-1 routing contracts for dynamic AI task dispatch. Classifies tasks into three complexity tiers (fast/light, coding/reasoning, complex/architecture), maps each tier to an optimal primary provider model with an ordered fallback cascade, and encodes cost-aware token-budget routing rules. Provider identifiers reuse the providerId pattern SSOT'd in provider-registry.schema.json; the router never invents providers — unknown providers are rejected by validation and unknown tasks by the fail-closed default. See issue #27.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this routing policy document (e.g. "1.0").

router_id.description: Stable identifier of the router policy instance (e.g. "federation-task-router").

complexity_tiers.description: Exactly the 3 complexity tiers, each present exactly once: allOf-of-contains clauses below pin ordinals 1..3 (monotonic capability, higher tier handles harder tasks).

routing_table.description: Exactly one route mapping per complexity tier: allOf-of-contains clauses pin tiers 1..3.

allOf.description: A route for tier 1 must exist.
A route for tier 2 must exist.
A route for tier 3 must exist.

ComplexityTier.description: One rung of the 3-tier task complexity ladder.

tier.description: Ordinal; higher tier implies harder tasks and stronger models.

name.description: Canonical tier name; name and ordinal are pinned together by the router renderer.

description.description: What class of work this tier serves.

example_signals.description: Observable task signals that classify a request into this tier (deterministic classification inputs).

RouteMapping.description: Tier → primary model + ordered fallback cascade (model-chain orchestration).

tier.description: The complexity tier this route serves.

fallback_cascade.description: Ordered model chain tried after the primary fails; first entry is tried first. Mirrors the failover_cascade semantics of provider-registry.schema.json at model granularity.

ModelEndpoint.description: One routable model endpoint: provider identity plus concrete model name.

provider.description: Provider id — enum pinned to the currently registered provider ids in provider-registry.schema.json (pattern SSOT: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$). Keep in sync when the registry grows; the router's unknown_provider=reject default gives this enum load-time teeth.

model.description: Provider-specific model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, deepseek-chat.

max_context_tokens.description: Context ceiling of this endpoint; router consults it against the task's estimated input size.

cost_per_1k_tokens_usd.description: Blended per-1k-token cost used by the budget rules.

CostBudgetRules.description: Cost-aware token budget routing rules, evaluated deterministically in listed order.

per_task_max_input_tokens.description: Hard input ceiling per task; tasks above it are downgraded to the cascade or rejected per rules.

max_cost_per_task_usd.description: Estimated total cost above which the reroute rule fires.

budget_floor_usd.description: Remaining-budget threshold below which only cheaper-tier routing is permitted.

rules.description: Ordered when→then routing rules; first match wins.

when.description: Trigger condition evaluated against the task estimate and live provider telemetry.

unclassifiable_task.description: Tasks that match no complexity tier are rejected, never guessed onto a route.

unknown_provider.description: Routes referencing providers absent from the provider registry are rejected at load time.
